title: Eye Tree in Starry Night
description: A surreal night landscape dominated by a gnarled, tree-like creature with a single large realistic human eye for a head. The eye has long eyelashes and gazes toward the right. The creature emerges from a barren, undulating golden-brown terrain that curves like a wave. In the dark blue sky are three moons of varying sizes, numerous golden stars, and a distant gothic castle silhouette on the horizon.
